messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On 18 January 2027, is Directive 2006/42/EC still in force (not yet repealed)?

response.text: Il 18 January 2027, la Direttiva 2006/42/CE è ancora in vigore (non ancora abrogata)?
